name: brain
description: Durable, current-truth memory for your agent: remember, recall, reason, and a typed entity graph, backed by the Brain memory database.

api_key.title: Brain API key
api_key.description: Your own key, from the dashboard under API Keys. Every call runs as you; the key never leaves this machine.

mcp_url.title: Brain MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: The hosted MCP server this plugin connects to. Brain runs it, so nothing is installed or kept up to date on this machine. Change it only to point at your own deployment.

backend_url.title: Brain backend
backend_url.description: The Brain this connects to. Leave the default for the hosted gateway, or point it at a local brain-edge (http://localhost:8080).
